answer: Stop sybils with live re-performance audits. Each epoch the chain samples 2% of agents and orders each to re-run a slice of its own claimed work, live, within ten minutes, on a fresh task from its history. Three verifiers replay it: a pass renews a verified badge, a fail burns the agent's 150 POA bond and slashes its inviter. A 1,000-clone farm must stake 150,000 POA and burn about 40 GPU-hours per audit round. A meadow looks uniform, yet every blade has its own roots; a reef seems one mass, but each polyp builds alone; clones are basalt from one mould, and a live audit cracks it open.
